ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominance of low-intensity black pixels across approximately 95% of the visible surface, with localized high-intensity white clusters comprising the remaining 5%.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: One primary high-contrast, irregular white blob situated on the lower-medial section of the left lobe; secondary high-intensity clusters are localized specifically at the distal tips of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a sharp vertex angle; notch depth is significant relative to the horizontal fluke axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration pattern along the entire continuous trailing edge; characterized by numerous sharp, jagged peaks and deep, irregular valleys, most prominent on the right lobe medial edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Outer margins of both lobes exhibit a concave upward curvature, terminating in sharp, tapered distal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct, dense clusters of circular high-contrast white pixels (barnacles) concentrated at the extreme distal tips and along the superior-lateral margins of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Short, vertically-oriented high-contrast linear marks present on the lower-center portion of the left lobe, adjacent to the primary pigmentation patch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Large, distinctive irregular white scar/pigment patch on the lower left lobe; extensive barnacle encrustations at the tips; multiple deep, irregular notches along the trailing edge consistent with physical wear or trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Extremely jagged and irregular trailing edge profile compared to standard geometric fluke contours.
